maps: Use the registered 218 external Master6 training maps and 18 holdout maps; standard 10-map validation for reporting only. Use the same retained public roots, before seeing future receipts. Within each root predict every currently living positive-cargo opposing collector, from Master6's physical perspective. Deadline or real early extinction truncates further deposits to zero. No actor actions, names, game outcomes or seed in the predictor.
labels: For each identified root worker within its own team's nearest destinations track the unit's ID over t+1..min(t+10,game end). Main amount marks its current cargo. With registered smeltCost=moveCost=0, new collection/looted cargo add no tagged principal. Actual proportional tree taxation reduces surviving marked cargo as it reduces every unit of its carrying balance. First cash deposit by the same UID to its own base settles remaining marked cargo, a gift to another team's base or death loses it. This is an explicit proportional accounting convention within fungible cargo. Auxiliary target is existence of any strictly positive own-bank event by that original UID. Additionally record sum of actual gross own deposits, which can exceed starting cargo. Validate cash, roster/worker identity, balances against all official frames.
features: Same-seat public player tables, time and prior t-3/t-5 observations only; current cargo/own base distance, travel direction/staying/cargo trend, lighter defender proximity, safe first steps on a shortest path, nearby supporting workers, threatening trees and route obstruction. No hidden carbon or forward observation. Unknown past is flagged; all feature inputs drawn before any intervention.
model: Two small histogram gradient boosting estimators with sklearn, 70 rounds, depth 3, max_leaf_nodes 8, learning_rate .065, L2 2.0, no early stop, seed 910739, squared error to root-principal fraction clipped to [0,1] and log loss to actual yes/no. Serialize split/threshold/leaf values for pure Python JSON inference. Train even if held-out outcome is unfavorable. Inputs logged explicitly. No holdout choice of architecture, parameters or threshold.
baseline: Fit identical estimator families restricted to current cargo and own-base distance. A map has the same aggregate sample weight as any other. Public performance reports map-equal expected principal cash MAE, fraction MSE, binary Brier/log loss and recorded gross revenue; legacy interactions inside ten steps make all reported counts map-clustered. Separately report held maps against opponent names never present at training. Also give nearest-only or trivial baseline if none unseen.
live_check: On already exposed official full-response double-network candidate on 621458920, inspect seat0 t234 and seat1 t157 under the same blind predictor, freeze before inspection; actual 10-step receipts and specific worker principal reported separately after computing predictions. Both roots were selected retrospectively from severe swings; observational forecasts do not identify a profitable response. No formal game or run started.
cpu: one single CPU core, sklearn threads fixed to one.
